description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/SearchProduct/StockChanges. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Reads the recorded stock quantity change history shown in HGRWeb for one listing variation. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: listing_stock_history. Operation: read_history. Scope: exact_variation. Use when: Use it when the user asks for stock history, stock changes, quantity changes, inventory history or an availability timeline of an identified or attached store product. Current stock in the product details is not its history. Input: Required query id: positive internal ListingVariationId, not the parent ListingId, supplier ProductSourceId or marketplace Product ID. Resolve the attached product's visible Product ID through Listing/GetListings in the selected channel; use the matching variation Id. If several variations match, resolve the requested variation rather than choosing one arbitrarily. Output: Returns History entries with Date, Value (channel stock quantity), Author and Why when recorded. A successful History: [] means no recorded stock changes for that variation. success=false or a missing History is a failed lookup, not evidence of no history. Search terms: searchproduct stockchanges. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
